title: Explicit VP set-multilinear polynomial with near-optimal depth-sensitive formula lower bounds

standard_prerequisites.name: Symmetric-word relative-rank bounds of Kush–Saraf [22] and elementary rank algebra
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact imported Lemmas11–12 and relative-rank properties are retained in the transcription; author does not reprove these cited background bounds.

core_obligations: Construct the explicit set-multilinear polynomial by recursive interval splitting.
Use Dyck-word matching and an auxiliary-variable specialization to prove full rank.
Combine the full-rank specialization with the imported symmetric-word bounds to prove both depth-sensitive and arbitrary-depth lower bounds.
difficulty_reason: Non-routine Dyck-word combinatorics isolate an inner-product matching through auxiliary variables, then a rational-function rank argument and conditioned symmetric-word bounds yield the formula lower bounds. Both depth regimes form one author construction.
